Wie die Website von Dwello mit Personend: How the Dwello website handles personal data: no cookies, no tracking, only the web server's logs.
Diese Erklärung gilt für die Website von: This statement applies to the Dwello website. It does not apply to the Dwello app that you install yourself. You are responsible for your tenants' data in the app. The app comes with its own privacy statement for that.
Diese Website setzt keine Cookies und mi: This website sets no cookies and does not measure what you do.
Sie lädt nichts von fremden Servern, auc: It loads nothing from other servers, no fonts and no videos either.
Bearbeitet werden nur die Angaben, die j: The only data processed is what every web server logs when a page is requested, and your email if you write to us.
Wir speichern alle Daten in der Schweiz: We store all data in Switzerland and pass none of it abroad.
Ihr Browser sendet bei jedem Aufruf tech: With every request your browser sends technical details to the web server. The server logs them: your IP address, date and time, the address requested, the page you came from, and the browser and operating system as your browser reports them.
Diese Protokolle braucht der Server, um: The server needs these logs to deliver the website, find faults and fend off attacks. We do not analyse them, build no profiles from them and do not combine them with other data.
Schreiben Sie an info@dwello.ch, bearbei: If you write to info@dwello.ch, we process your email address and the content of your message to reply to you. We delete the message once it is dealt with, unless a legal duty requires us to keep it. We do not publish your message, not on GitHub either, unless you agree.
Wir setzen keine Cookies und speichern n: We set no cookies and store nothing in your browser. We use no analytics or advertising services, no social media plugins and no embedded content from other providers.
Die Website liegt beim Schweizer Hoster: The website is hosted by the Swiss host Infomaniak Network SA in Geneva, in data centres in Switzerland. Infomaniak processes the web server's logs and the emails to info@dwello.ch on our behalf and only to run these services. Otherwise we pass your data to no one, unless the law requires us to, and never abroad. If we reply to your email, the reply goes to your email provider, even if it is abroad.
Die Protokolle des Webservers bewahrt In: Infomaniak keeps the web server's logs for as long as operation and security require, and deletes them afterwards. We delete emails, as described above, once they are dealt with.
Die Website verlinkt auf GitHub, wo der: The website links to GitHub, where Dwello's source code lives, and to the demo at demo.dwello.ch. If you follow such a link, the privacy statement of that provider applies there. The demo has its own privacy statement.
Sie können jederzeit Auskunft verlangen,: You can ask at any time what data we process about you. You can ask us to correct wrong data, to delete data or stop processing it, and to hand your data over to you. Write to info@dwello.ch for this. Access is free of charge, and you receive the information within 30 days. We may ask you to prove your identity.
Sie können sich jederzeit an den Eidgenö: You can contact the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC) at any time: Feldeggweg 1, 3003 Bern,
. Ihre Rechte können Sie auch vor einem: . You can also assert your rights before a civil court.
Ändern wir die Website so, dass sie ande: If we change the website so that it processes other data, we update this statement. The version published here applies.
Dwello rechnet nach den Regeln des Mietr: Dwello calculates by the rules of Swiss tenancy law and shows, for each category, the building’s costs, the apartment share and the days rented. Your tenants see the same breakdown in the PDF: Hans Müller in apartment 1.01 of Musterhaus Zentrum, for example, owes CHF 215.80 for 2025. Check every statement before you send it: Dwello is no substitute for legal advice.
Beträge unter CHF 5 werden nicht sofort: Amounts under CHF 5 are neither claimed nor paid out right away but carried over to the next statement. The final statement after move-out settles every amount.
Kosten nach Fläche, Zimmern, Einheiten o: Costs by area, rooms, units or a custom formula, say 70 % by area and 30 % per apartment. Heating costs follow a heating profile: a day rented in January counts more than one in summer. One profile each is included for the Central Plateau, the mountains and Ticino, plus one for heating with hot water.
Kleine Geräte nutzen besser eine externe: Small devices are better off with an external AI. What then goes out is listed under Privacy.
Die Anleitung zeigt, wie Caddy HTTPS aut: The guide shows how Caddy sets up HTTPS automatically.
Ja. Dwello ist Open Source und kostenlos: Yes. Dwello is open source and free. At most you pay for your own server or the power for your PC, and the postage for letters. If you use an external AI instead of the local one, you pay the provider directly.
